title: Art. 5.19.1 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 5 - Inadmissible Persons and Deportees, C. Deportees, 5.19.1
content:
The aircraft operator and/or the pilot- in- command shall have the option to refuse to transport a deportee on a specific flight when reasonable concerns relating to the safety and security of the flight in question exist.

Note.- Reference is made to the ICAO Aviation Security Manual (Doc 8973 - Restricted), paragraphs 12.2.1.3 and 12.2.1.6.
